Get an object by its ID.



The object kind is inferred from the ID format (e.g., ITEM-001 -> backlog_item).



Full object is loaded and merged with overlays first; optional --fields then
keeps only those

top-level keys (same hybrid projection as object list).

  Get a backlog item
  zqk get ITEM-626
  Get with JSON output
  zqk get ITEM-626 --format json
  Get with YAML output
  zqk get ITEM-626 --format yaml
  Milestone completion report slice
  zqk get MIL-001 --view milestone-completion-report
  JSON with selected keys only (projection)
  zqk get PROMPT-001 --fields prompt_body --format json

Usage:
  zqk object get [flags]

Aliases:
  get, show, view

Flags:
      --fields stringArray      Top-level keys to include in output (repeat or comma-separated); same hybrid projection as list. Omit for full object after overlays. Put -h before --fields if you need help so '-h' is not parsed as a field name.
      --link-hydration string   Reference overlay: lazy (one hop), default (balanced), or eager (deeper). Omit to use kind and --view defaults (pkg/objectget).
      --view string             Optional view name to scope output fields (default: full object with reference-resolver overlay).

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
